faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the RDPR Tiruchirappalli Jeep Driver recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application for the RDPR Tiruchirappalli Jeep Driver recruitment is 09 October 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address before this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the minimum qualification required for the Jeep Driver post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed the 8th standard. Additionally, a valid driving license under the Motor Vehicles Act 1988 and a minimum of 5 years of driving experience are mandatory.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Jeep Driver position?
faq.answer: The age limit for the Jeep Driver post is between 18 years and 42 years. Specific age relaxations are applicable for certain categories as mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive. Candidates can apply without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Jeep Driver post?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Jeep Driver post will receive a salary in the pay scale of Rs. 19500 to Rs. 71900 per month.

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available for the Jeep Driver post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Jeep Driver post in the Rural Development and Panchayat Unit Tiruchirappalli.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the application form and send it via post.

faq.question: Q8. What are the selection criteria for the Jeep Driver role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Jeep Driver post will involve an Interview and Document Verification. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their performance in these stages.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I download the application form?
faq.answer: The application form can be downloaded from the official website of the Rural Development and Panchayat Unit Tiruchirappalli, which is www.tiruchirappalli.nic.in.

faq.question: Q10. What documents are required to be submitted with the application form?
faq.answer: Candidates need to attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and relevant certificates along with the application form.
